text:
nora: Heads up  our daily healthscore batch bumped 87 enterprise accounts into "renewal-risk" overnight. AMs seeing sudden churn flags and asking for explanation. Quick sample looks like recency was imputed from marketing embeddings rather than last_activity, and that imputation failed for certain domains.

ben: I pulled a sample. The new "recency_impute_v2" uses an embedding model to estimate last_active_ts when telemetry is missing, but for emails behind secure gateways the model returns epoch-like values (very old). That made recency look stale.

cs-ops-bot: healthscore-run 3498765432 completed 03:14:12 flagged=87 reason=recency_impute_v2 (:warning:)

frank: Oof. Do we have a quick mitigation? We should prefer explicit signals over imputed ones. If telemetry missing and imputed_confidence < 0.6 then fallback to "unknown" not "very_old".

olga (data-eng): Agreed. I can patch scorer to clamp imputed_ts to be no older than 30d when confidence < 0.6, and expose a dry-run flag. Will open PR and run a sampled dry-run. PR: https://git.redwood/s/data/score/+/4587 (patch: clamp-impute-confidence).

mike: Also, until we patch, can we revert the deploy of recency_impute_v2? It was rolled this morning. A rollback would stop further noisy flags.

tara: Rollback will take ~15min and impacts downstream experiments. I think quick patch + dry-run might be faster. If olga's dry-run shows >80% reduction in false positives we can keep the model.

nora: Plan: olga runs dry-run over impacted cohort, compute before/after flags, and we mute renewal alerts while we analyze. If dry-run is good, merge patch and canary. If not, rollback.

olga (data-eng): Running dry-run command now:

```
./bin/healthscore --cohort enterprise-q4 --dry-run --patch clamp_impute_conf --sample 2k --out s3://redwood-cs/dryruns/3498765432/results.json
```

ETA ~12m. I'll post the delta and a small CSV of affected acct_ids.

cs-ops-bot: healthscore-dryrun queued 3498765432 sample=2000 mode=dry-run (:hourglass_flowing_sand:)

ben: Nora, I'll draft an AM note template explaining root cause and that we're running a corrective dry-run. Keep it short and include reassurance we won't change contracts.

mike: Muted healthscore alerts for tag=recency-impute until 3498766200 to avoid noise.

nora: Thanks. One more ask: please include `impute_confidence` and `impute_source` columns in the dry-run CSV so AMs can triage by source/model. If a particular source/domain is failing we may need to blacklist it from imputation.

olga (data-eng): Will include those columns. Also logging indicates the embedding model returns zero vectors for domains using gateway redaction; we'll add a source blacklist in the model router. If dry-run looks good I'll add that to the patch.

cs-ops-bot: dry-run complete 3498765432 -> before_flagged=87 after_flagged=8 reduction=90% (s3://redwood-cs/dryruns/3498765432/results.json) :white_check_mark:

frank: That's promising. Olga, please proceed with merge and canary to 5% for 24h. Also add an alert if impute_confidence < 0.2 for >1% of cohort within 30m.

olga (data-eng): Merged to staging, queuing canary deploy. Will also add blacklist and the confidence alert.

mike: Canary scheduled. I'll keep alerts muted for now and unmute after we confirm stability.

tara: Once canary is stable, let's rerun the healthscore for the impacted accounts to correct labels, and send AM note with attached CSV and explanation. Ben, can you finalize the AM note?

ben: On it. Draft will say: root cause = imputation edge-case for gateway-redacted domains; mitigation = clamp impute age, blacklist problem sources, rerun and restore flags; timeline + next steps.

nora: Thanks team. Add follow-up to retro: require a dry-run window + alert suppression step for model-driven scoring changes. Also add a quick smoke test simulating redacted embedding input. Closing for now, will update thread after canary results. :thumbsup:
